title: FlowPlan: Reducing the Token Cost of Coding Agents with Abstraction-Guided Planning and Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.13241v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code can resolve real-world repository issues, but their iterative interaction loop can be expensive. Existing approaches reduce this cost primarily by limiting, compressing, or selectively avoiding information and actions within the repair process. We investigate a complementary question: Can an agent reason about a repair at an abstract program level, rather than repeatedly operating over raw source code, to reduce both the exploration needed to identify a repair and the repeated checking needed to verify it afterward?   We present FlowPlan, an abstraction-guided repair approach that structures localization, planning, and verification around per-function control-flow or data-flow graphs. The agent first localizes the candidate fault location on the program abstraction and expresses the intended repair as explicit graph deltas before modifying the concrete source. translated_title: FlowPlan：通过抽象引导的规划与验证降低编码智能体的Token成本
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的编码智能体（如Claude Code）能够解决真实世界代码库中的问题，但其迭代交互循环的成本可能很高。现有方法主要是通过限制、压缩或选择性地避免修复过程中的信息与操作来降低这一成本。我们研究了一个互补的问题：智能体能否在抽象的程序层面进行修复推理，而不是反复操作原始源代码，从而同时减少定位修复所需的探索以及事后验证所需的重复检查？我们提出了FlowPlan，这是一种抽象引导的修复方法，它围绕每个函数的控制流图或数据流图来组织定位、规划与验证。智能体首先在程序抽象上定位候选故障位置，并在修改具体源代码之前，将预期的修复表达为显式的图差异（graph deltas）。编辑完成后，FlowPlan会重新……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FlowPlan提出了一种抽象引导的修复方法，让编码智能体基于函数级控制流/数据流图完成故障定位、以显式图差异形式表达修复计划并进行验证，从而在抽象层面推理修复，显著降低基于LLM的编码智能体的Token成本。
en_tdlr: FlowPlan reduces the token cost of LLM-based coding agents by structuring fault localization, planning (expressed as explicit graph deltas), and verification around per-function control-flow or data-flow graphs, allowing agents to reason about repairs at an abstract program level instead of repeatedly operating on raw source code.
